behaviors.description: Activation data, ATS length boundaries, and field-cycle state.
ISO-DEP request chaining, block numbering, retries, and response framing.
Native, wrapped-native, and standard ISO command dialects.
Standard ISO file selection and file-command rejection behavior.
Legacy-compatible, ISO, AES, and EV2 authentication families.
MACed and enciphered commands, protected responses, and chained EV2 data.
Application and file creation plus observable storage effects.
Standard and backup data reads, writes, chaining, and commit readback.
Linear and cyclic record writes, reads, ordering, and capacity.
Value-file communication modes, rights, credit, debit, and limited credit.
Native transactions and standard ISO publication behavior.
EV2 key-set zero and nonzero ChangeKeyEV2 behavior.
Transaction MAC creation, commit output, and reader identification.
Secure dynamic messaging rendering, encrypted data, counters, and limits.
Proximity preparation, verification, wrong-key output, and session effects.
Random ID, formatting controls, and configuration command protection.
Delegated application creation, authentication, and lifecycle.
Authenticated virtual-card selection and configured rejection.
Key mutation survives a physical field cycle and reauthentication.
Version chain, identity, and static-signature response surface.
Transaction timer capability and time-dependent command behavior.
